items.t: Iovance Biotherapeutics Targets 2027 Lung Cancer Filing as AMTAGVI Sales Climb

items.t: BUZZ Investing: AI Reassessment Drives Tech Rotation, BUZZ Index Declines
items.sum: Stocks Fell on AI Reassessment: The S&P 500 fell 2.2% and the Nasdaq Composite 6.7%, while the BUZZ Index declined 14.9% as investors rotated out of AI and semiconductors.
